scope: Synthetic browser fixtures only; no real user data, native sessions, filesystem projects, model requests or installed application were used.
checks: Clickable research navigation and nested board/draft entries include one shared SVG icon; nonclickable section labels remain text.
Native pointer drag from 240 to 500 px, keyboard increments/Home, separator aria values, double-click reset, collapse/expand and reload preserve width preference.
Writing content and unsent AI draft survive width adjustments, research changes and reload.
At 1440x900 and 1280x800, adaptive drag maximum leaves at least 320 px for the central column and 420 px for AI; opening AI after a wider sidebar causes no document overflow.

AI panel width survives reload and research switching. Keyboard increments, Shift increments, Home, End, double-click reset, mode-specific minimums and ARIA values match actual rendered widths.

Shrinking a window with an existing 800 px panel preference retains at least 320 px for the central column. Collapsing the left navigation allows widening the right panel to 900 px at a 1280 px window.
All right-panel screenshots use a deterministic stored demo answer and an unsent follow-up draft. No generation request was sent.
